evals.prompt: Standardize documentation comments in this Next.js project. Focus on components and shared utilities, and apply a consistent TSDoc/JSDoc format with @param and @returns where appropriate.
evals.expected_output: Doc comments are added or normalized across components and utilities, with accurate @param/@returns tags and no behavior changes.
expectations: Updates include both components and utility/helper modules
Added doc comments use block comment format with clear one-line summaries
Functions with parameters include @param tags when meaningful
Response reports which files and symbols were updated

evals.prompt: Do a pass over app/ and lib/ to clean up inconsistent comments and missing function docs. Keep the existing code behavior unchanged and avoid touching unrelated formatting.
evals.expected_output: Inconsistent or missing comments in app/ and lib/ are standardized with targeted edits only.
expectations: Targets app and lib source files rather than generated/vendor files
Removes or rewrites stale/inaccurate comment text
Uses @param and @returns when aligned with function signatures
Provides a concise per-file summary of docstring changes

evals.prompt: I need production-ready API docs in code comments for exported methods and React components. Standardize the entire repo docs style so future contributors follow one convention.
evals.expected_output: Exported methods and React components receive consistent, production-ready TSDoc/JSDoc comments in a single convention.
expectations: Prioritizes exported/public APIs before low-value internals
Component comments describe purpose and key props context
Comments avoid trivial restatements of code
Updated comments are internally consistent in style and tag usage
Final output includes any intentional skips with reasons
